thread:
maria: Quick follow-up from today's postmortem — collecting owners for the remediation items (missing spans, bad aggregation, ETL lag). See doc: https://redwood.internal/postmortem/195555 — TL;DR: sampler bug dropped ~3% of spans at high qps, aggregation double-count on hourly rollups for services with multi-region, and ETL pipeline falls behind during peak traffic windows. I sketched proposed owners below; please confirm or reassign and add an ETA.

kevin: I can take the sampler bug. Plan: write unit tests + deploy feature-flagged fix. ETA 2w. Test plan uses the synthetic-load harness.

olivia: I’ll own the aggregation issue. Likely root cause is integer overflow + wrong merge order in rollups. I can produce fix + add property-based checks. ETA 1w for fix, 2w for backfill plan.

sam: I’ll handle the ETL lag. Quick wins: tune consumer batch size, add backpressure and a small autoscaler for peak hours. Longer term: split hot partitions. ETA: quick wins in 4 days.

kevin: adding note — before unflagging, we should run the sampler patch against staging with the 75th/95th QPS replay. Command I ran locally: `./harness/replay --qps 120 --span-sim=prod-sample`

olivia: for backfill: suggest incremental re-aggregation by day + dedupe using (service, window, sum_id). Will need 24-48h of extra storage. Can we provision a temp cluster?

maria: proposal: kevin (sampler) ETA 2w, olivia (aggregation) ETA 1w + backfill plan 2w, sam (ETL) quick wins 4d. dmitri in ops to own temp cluster provisioning and backfill ops.

dmitri: I can provision the temp cluster for backfill. Need exact node counts. Olivia, can you list expected CPU/RAM/storage in the tracker?

olivia: yes — adding numbers to the doc now. Will put conservative estimate: 8 nodes x m5.4xlarge equivalent, 48TB total local storage.

sam: ops-bot, can you create a recurring runbook check for the ETL lag metric (etl.processing_lag_seconds > 300) at 6am and 2pm weekdays?

ops-bot: Created recurring check: `etl-lag-daily` schedule Mon-Fri 06:00, 14:00 UTC. Alert channel: #incidents, runbook link attached.

kevin: also adding a canary to the sampler patch: mark a small % of traffic and compare spans emitted vs control for 24h. :eyes:

maria: great. Two action items for everyone: 1) add your owner item in the postmortem tracker with checklist + ETA, 2) update by EOD Friday if any ETA changes. I’ll do a roundup on Monday. :shipit:

sam: noted. I’ll post the PRs and the autoscaler plan in the tracker.

dmitri: will start provisioning once olivia posts sizes.

maria: thanks all — ping me if you hit blockers.
